corn_common_rust_overview: Corn Common Rust. Raised golden-brown pustules appear on upper and lower leaf surfaces.
corn_gray_leaf_spot_overview: Corn Gray Leaf Spot. Rectangular tan to gray lesions develop bounded by leaf veins.
corn_healthy_overview: Healthy Corn leaf. Foliage is clear and green with no active fungal lesions.
corn_northern_leaf_blight_overview: Corn Northern Leaf Blight. Long cigar-shaped grayish-green to tan lesions on foliage.
grape_black_rot_overview: Grape Black Rot. Circular reddish-brown leaf spots with tiny dark fruiting bodies.
grape_esca_overview: Grape Esca disease. Distinctive tiger-stripe yellow and brown scorching between veins.
grape_leaf_blight_overview: Grape Leaf Blight. Irregular dark brown lesions coalesce causing premature leaf dry-up.
pest_armyworm_overview: Fall Armyworm observation. Ragged foliage chewing holes and sawdust-like frass on whorls.
pest_asiatic_rice_borer_overview: Asiatic Rice Borer observation. Dead hearts during vegetative phase and whiteheads at maturity.
pest_brown_planthopper_overview: Brown Planthopper observation. Sap sucking at stem bases causing circular hopper burn drying.
pest_corn_borer_overview: Corn Borer observation. Tunnels inside stems with broken tassels and leaf shot holes.
pest_rice_leaf_roller_overview: Rice Leaf Roller observation. Leaves folded longitudinally with white transparent streaks.
potato_early_blight_overview: Potato Early Blight. Target-like concentric rings on older lower foliage spreading upward.
potato_healthy_overview: Healthy Potato foliage. Green vigorous leaves without fungal lesions or signs of rot.
potato_late_blight_overview: Potato Late Blight. Rapid water-soaked dark lesions with white mold under humid conditions.
tomato_bacterial_spot_overview: Tomato Bacterial Spot. Small dark water-soaked spots with yellow halos on leaves and stems.
tomato_early_blight_overview: Tomato Early Blight. Concentric bullseye rings with yellow margins on lower mature leaves.
tomato_healthy_overview: Healthy Tomato leaf. Vibrant green foliage with intact margins and no visible lesions.
tomato_late_blight_overview: Tomato Late Blight. Fast spreading dark greasy spots with whitish downy fungal growth underneath.
tomato_leaf_mold_overview: Tomato Leaf Mold. Pale green or yellow spots on upper surface with olive-green mold below.
tomato_septoria_leaf_spot_overview: Tomato Septoria Leaf Spot. Numerous small circular spots with gray centers and dark brown margins.
tomato_yellow_leaf_curl_overview: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus. Severe upward cupping, leaf yellowing, and stunted plant growth.
tomato_early_blight_treatment: Step 1: Remove and burn the infected lower leaves. Step 2: Spray a neem-based solution in the evening. Step 3: Water at the base, not over the leaves. If it keeps spreading, use a fungicide registered for tomato. Follow the label exactly and wear gloves and a mask when spraying.
tomato_early_blight_prevention: Step 1: Mulch the soil around plants to prevent soil spores splashing onto lower leaves. Step 2: Maintain 45-60 cm distance between tomato plants for healthy air circulation. Step 3: Practice 3-year crop rotation; avoid planting tomatoes after potatoes or eggplants. Farmer pro tip: Thoroughly destroy crop residue after harvest to break the fungal pathogen cycle for the next season.
tomato_late_blight_treatment: Step 1: Remove and destroy severely infected plants immediately. Step 2: Spray a copper-based or approved protective fungicide to shield surrounding crops. Step 3: Avoid moisture on foliage. Wear protective gear and strictly follow label dosage instructions.
tomato_late_blight_prevention: Step 1: Use only certified healthy seeds and transplants. Step 2: Ensure adequate spacing and airflow so foliage dries quickly. Step 3: Scout fields regularly during rainy or humid spells. Farmer pro tip: Cool, wet weather accelerates late blight; take action at the first sign of water-soaked spots.
tomato_healthy_treatment: No treatment required. Your tomato foliage is healthy, vibrant, and free of active fungal lesions.
tomato_healthy_prevention: Prevention tips: Maintain balanced nutrition and steady watering. Keep foliage dry and space plants adequately for good air movement.
